utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, still on—I can help out this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I might need a few tools, but I’m still sorting out what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — take your time and send me the list when you’ve got it sorted. I’ll set aside anything I can spare for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout so far. If you need anything checked, I can pass the word along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — that’s helpful. I’m just trying to figure out the timing and whether they’re set up for everything they might need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’d swing by a little early if you can — that way you can see what they still need and catch the setup before it gets busy.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you check the shed by Maple Street for the spare tools and bring them over?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the shed by Maple Street and bring the spare tools over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’ve been telling folks about it already—want me to pass your name along too?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add your name to the list and let people know you’re in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’ve got the repair drive organized and ready. Want to go over the list of supplies and timing together?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — send me the list and the start time, and I’ll check what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — we’re starting at 9:00 AM on Saturday, and the main supplies are gloves, trash bags, duct tape, a screwdriver set, and extra extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again so I can double-check everything before we go?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m still piecing it together too, but I can share what I know and we can double-check it together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — please tell me the time, location, and what tools or parts we should bring, and I’ll check each detail with you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send you the repair drive details next so we can line it up around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send it over when you can and I’ll fit it around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming up, but I’m still piecing together the details. If you know anything specific, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve heard it’s this Saturday at the community hall, and folks are bringing tools, supplies, and a few volunteers to help fix up bikes and small appliances. If you want, I can check on the exact time and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m especially curious about the exact time and what they still need most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: It’s the one for the community repairs, right? Just checking I’ve got the right drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start with a quick list of what needs fixing and who can help, then we can sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—do you want a hand with anything for it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be lovely—thank you. I’m a bit scattered, but I could use help sorting what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I can help you make a quick list and sort it by priority. If you want, we can go through it together when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. I’ll keep repeating the plan so everyone hears it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Vik—thank you. I’ll keep track of the supplies and make sure we know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good—I’ll keep repeating the plan and let folks know what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you keeping an ear out. I’ll let you know if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’d be glad to help, just remind me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks Oren—please bring a screwdriver set and any spare bolts you’ve got. I’ll see you there and we’ll get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it—I’ll bring a screwdriver set and whatever spare bolts I can find. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I might’ve missed the details—what’s changing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly just the drop-off times and the list of accepted items. I can send you the quick details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please send me the quick details — I’ve probably missed a few things.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Gus. Let’s start with the basics: a hammer, a screwdriver set, and a tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I can lend those three. I’ll bring them by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Quinn—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara! Could you help spread the word and see who can donate tools or spare parts? I’ll put your name on the volunteer list too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll ask around and see who can donate tools or spare parts. Put me on the volunteer list, and I’ll report back soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect people for the repair drive—what kind of help do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Amazing, Mara—could you swing by Saturday morning and help coordinate tools and volunteers? I’ll pass along the details to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help with tools and volunteers on Saturday morning. Send me the details, and I’ll make sure everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help organize the repair drive and keep everything on track. What do you want me to coordinate first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Let’s start with the supply list and what we’re short on, then we can match people to pickups.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll draft the supply list and flag the gaps, then we can assign pickup pairs based on who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting started soon—if you know the details, could you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t know the full schedule yet, but I can check and let you know. What part do you want to know most?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly when and where it’s happening, so I can plan around it. If you hear anything, just pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just give me the quick version of what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I just need you to help move a few things and let me know what time works best around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can help move a few things. Just tell me the pickup time, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re really helping with the repair drive, right? If so, could you confirm what you can bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?
